d: Rolan draws Excalibur, cleansing the dispellable debuffs from his allies and redistributing the HP of all non-summoned allies so they are at the same percentage. He then increases all allies' max HP by [[150%]] and restores [[1000%]]<ATK> HP. The max HP gained from this skill gradually decays over [[12]]s. Casting this skill also grants Rolan's allies [[15%]] Morale.
Increases HP restored to [[1050%]]<ATK>.
Increases HP restored to [[1100%]]<ATK>.
Increases HP restored to [[1150%]]<ATK>.
Increases HP restored to [[1200%]]<ATK>.

Passive. When a battle starts, Rolan inspires his allies, granting the allied team [[20%]] Morale. For every [[20%]] Morale the team has, all allies gain ATK equal to [[10%]] of Rolan's initial ATK. The team's Morale is capped at [[100%]].
During combat, the allied team gains [[10%]] Morale whenever an ally casts an Ultimate. Defeating a non-summoned enemy grants [[10%]] Morale, while losing a non-summoned ally deducts the same amount. If Rolan is defeated, all Morale is permanently lost.
Active. Rolan blesses the 2 allies with the highest cumulative damage dealt, making them [[unaffected|uncontrol]] for [[10]]s and increasing their ATK by [[18%]] of Rolan's ATK. If the allied team has at least [[60%]] Morale, the blessed allies also gain [[50]] Haste while the blessing is active.
Increases the ATK bonus from the blessing to [[20%]] of Rolan's ATK.
Increases the ATK bonus from the blessing to [[22%]] of Rolan's ATK.
Increases the ATK bonus from the blessing to [[24%]] of Rolan's ATK.

Rolan targets the area with the most allies, restoring [[240%]]<ATK> HP to allies within 1 tile and reducing their damage taken by [[36%]] for [[10]]s. If the allied team has at least [[60%]] Morale, Rolan also targets the area with the most enemies, dealing [[240%]]<ATK> damage to enemies within 1 tile and stunning them for [[3]]s.
Increases the HP restored to [[260%]]<ATK> and the damage dealt to [[260%]]<ATK>.
Increases the HP restored to [[280%]]<ATK> and the damage dealt to [[280%]]<ATK>.
Increases the HP restored to [[300%]]<ATK> and the damage dealt to [[300%]]<ATK>.
Increases Healing by [[9]] and reduces damage taken by [[9%]]. For every [[20%]] Morale the allied team has, Rolan gains an extra [[3]] Healing and further reduces his damage taken by [[3%]].
Increases Healing by [[12]] and reduces damage taken by [[12%]]. For every [[20%]] Morale the allied team has, Rolan gains an extra [[4]] Healing and further reduces his damage taken by [[4%]].
Increases Healing by [[15]] and reduces damage taken by [[15%]]. For every [[20%]] Morale the allied team has, Rolan gains an extra [[5]] Healing and further reduces his damage taken by [[5%]].

Once the allied team's Morale reaches [[100%]], Rolan creates a radiant ward. When an ally casts their Ultimate, a radiant clone appears, inheriting [[80%]] of that ally's basic stats and casting their Ultimate again. While the ward is active, Morale will not decrease unless Rolan is defeated. In non-Boss battles, allies inside the ward are immune to stat reductions.
The radiant clone now inherits [[90%]] of the ally's basic stats.
The radiant clone now inherits [[100%]] of the ally's basic stats.
Allies within the radiant ward recover [[80%]]<ATK> HP every second, while all enemies within it lose [[40%]]<ATK> HP every second.

r.d: In Rivalry Mode, the first ally to drop below [[40%]] HP is healed for [[160%]]<ATK> HP and granted a shield equal to [[160%]]<ATK>.
Lvl. 4 Refinement: In Rivalry Mode, increases 10 Healing, 10 Haste.

d: When a battle starts, the allied team gains an extra [[6%]] Morale for each hero from the faction with the most deployed heroes. If that faction is the Lightbearer Empire or the Celestials, the Morale bonus increases by [[4%]] per hero, and Rolan and heroes from that faction also gain [[0]] Penetration and take [[0%]] less damage for [[0]]s.
